description: Fortive Corporation innovates essential technologies to keep the world safe and productive, and its strategic segments, Intelligent Operating Solutions and Advanced Healthcare Solutions, include iconic inventor brands with leading positions in their markets, with businesses that design, develop, manufacture and market products, software and services built upon leading brand names, innovative technologies and strong market positions. It is headquartered in Everett, Washington and has a workforce of more than 10,000 research and development, manufacturing, sales, distribution, service and administrative professionals in approximately 50 countries around the world, and on June 28, 2025 it separated its Precision Technologies segment business into an independent publicly-traded company named Ralliant Corporation through a tax-free spin-off for Fortive shareholders for U.S. federal income tax purposes.
